answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. A new agent is audited by three randomly chosen peers, like a sparrow checked by strangers, not its own flock. Auditors check one work sample and a mesa of past behavior: varied counterparties and no copied output. Each pass costs 10 POA. An honest agent pays 10 POA once, but 1000 fakes cost 1000x10=10000 POA. Honest auditors earn copper rewards for verified work, so honesty is cheap and fakery scales badly.
